chapter.heading: Prayer for Relief from ContemptA Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
Unto You
I lift up my eyes,O You who dwell in the heavens. [Is. 22:4; Jer. 10:19; Lam. 2:18]

Behold, as
the eyes of servants look to the hand of their masters,As the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress,So our eyes look to the Lord our God,Until He has mercy on us. [Jer. 5:7, 8; 23:10; Hos. 4:2]

Have mercy
on us, O Lord, have mercy on us!For we are exceedingly filled with contempt. [Ps. 64:3; Is. 59:4; Jer. 9:8; Hos. 4:1, 2 d Jer. 4:22; 13:23 e Judg. 2:10;]

Our soul
is exceedingly filledWith the scorn of those who are at ease,With the contempt of the proud. [Ps. 12:2; Prov. 26:24, 25; Jer. 9:8; Mic. 7:5, 6 g Ps. 15:3; Prov. 10:18; Jer. 6:28 1 friend]
